title: Benny Learns to Share 🥕
moral: Sharing makes everything sweeter.
lines: Benny the bunny found the biggest carrot in the whole forest!
It was shiny, orange, and almost as big as him.
His best friend Tiko the squirrel looked at it with hungry eyes.
"This carrot is all mine," Benny said, hugging it tight.
But eating alone under the big tree felt very quiet and lonely.
Benny looked at his carrot, then at his sad little friend.
He broke the carrot in two and gave Tiko the bigger piece.
Tiko smiled so wide that his whiskers wiggled.
Benny learned that sharing makes every snack taste twice as sweet.

title: Adam and Maya Say Bismillah 🍽️
moral: Start with Bismillah, and remember Allah in everything.
lines: Adam and Maya were sooo hungry after playing outside.
Mama put warm pancakes on the table, and they grabbed them fast!
"Wait!" said Grandpa with a smile. "What do we say before we eat?"
Maya thought hard. Then her eyes lit up. "Bismillah!"
Grandpa nodded. "It means, in the name of Allah."
"When we say it, we remember that every blessing comes from Him."
Adam and Maya said Bismillah together, and took a big bite.
"These are the best pancakes ever!" Adam laughed.
Now, they never forget to say Bismillah before they eat.

title: Lina and the Fallen Star ⭐
moral: Help others shine, and you will shine too.
lines: One night, Lina saw something glowing in her garden.
It was a tiny star that had fallen from the sky!
"I'm lost," the little star said. "I can't get back home."
Lina wanted to keep the star forever. It was so pretty!
But she saw how much the star missed the sky.
So Lina climbed to the top of the hill, holding the star gently.
She lifted her arms high, and the star floated up, up, up.
That night, one star twinkled brighter than all the others, just for her.
When you help others shine, your heart shines too.

title: Benny Saves a Baby Bird 🐦
moral: Kindness is a superpower.
lines: One windy morning, Benny heard a tiny cheep cheep in the grass.
A baby bird had fallen out of its nest, high up in the old oak tree.
"Don't worry, little one," Benny whispered. "I will help you."
But bunnies can't climb trees. What could he do?
Benny ran to his friend Bruno the bear and asked for help.
Bruno lifted Benny up, higher and higher, all the way to the nest.
Benny gently placed the baby bird next to its mommy.
The mommy bird sang the happiest song in the whole forest.
Benny smiled. Even small friends can do big, kind things.

title: The Ramadan Surprise 🌙
moral: Sharing food makes Ramadan even more special.
lines: It was Ramadan, and the house smelled of soup and dates.
Adam looked out the window at their old neighbor, Uncle Yusuf.
"He lives all alone," Adam said. "Who will he break his fast with?"
Maya had an idea. "Let's bring him iftar!"
They filled a plate with dates, soup and warm bread.
When Uncle Yusuf opened the door, his eyes filled with happy tears.
"May Allah bless you," he said. "You made my day so bright."
That night, Uncle Yusuf broke his fast with the whole family.
Adam and Maya learned that sharing is the true joy of Ramadan.

title: The New Girl at School 🎒
moral: Everyone needs a friend. Be the first to say hello.
lines: A new girl named Sara came to Lina's class.
She sat alone at lunch, looking down at her sandwich.
The other kids didn't talk to her. Sara looked very sad.
Lina remembered how scary her own first day was.
She walked over and said, "Hi! Do you want to sit with me?"
Sara's face lit up like the sun.
They shared cookies and found out they both loved painting.
Soon, Sara and Lina were the best of friends.
One small hello can change someone's whole day.

title: Benny Is Afraid of the Dark 🌙
moral: Being brave means trying, even when you feel scared.
lines: Every night, Benny pulled his blanket over his long, floppy ears.
"The dark is too scary," he whispered. "Something is out there!"
One night, he heard a strange sound. Hoo... hoo...
Benny's heart beat fast, but he decided to be brave and peek outside.
It was only Olivia the owl, sitting on a branch!
"The night is full of friends," Olivia said with a gentle smile.
She showed Benny the twinkling stars and the glowing fireflies.
The dark wasn't scary at all. It was beautiful!
From that night on, Benny slept with a smile, dreaming of stars.

title: Helping Mama 🧺
moral: Being kind to our parents is one of the best deeds.
lines: Mama was very tired. She had cooked, cleaned, and washed all day.
Adam and Maya were playing with their toys on the floor.
Maya saw Mama rubbing her back and sighing softly.
"Adam," she whispered, "let's help Mama!"
Adam folded the clothes. Maya set the table with tiny careful hands.
They even made Mama a cup of warm mint tea.
Mama hugged them both. "You are my little helpers!"
In Islam, being kind to our parents is one of the best things we can do.
And helping Mama made Adam and Maya feel happy inside.

title: Lina Learns to Ride a Bike 🚲
moral: Never give up. Every fall makes you stronger.
lines: Lina got a shiny pink bike for her birthday!
She hopped on, pushed the pedals, and... boom! She fell.
She tried again. Wobble, wobble... boom!
"I can't do it!" Lina cried, rubbing her knee.
Papa knelt down. "Every great rider fell many times. Try once more."
Lina took a deep breath and pushed the pedals again.
Wobble... wobble... and then... she was riding!
The wind blew through her hair as she laughed and laughed.
Lina learned that you only fail when you stop trying.

title: Benny Plants a Magic Seed 🌱
moral: Good things take time. Be patient.
lines: Grandma Bunny gave Benny a tiny seed. "Plant it, and wait," she said.
Benny planted it, watered it, and stared at the ground.
Nothing happened. "Grow faster!" he shouted.
The next day, still nothing. Benny almost gave up.
But he kept watering it every single morning.
One day, a little green sprout popped out of the soil!
Then it grew, and grew, into a giant sunflower taller than his house.
"You were patient," Grandma Bunny smiled. "And look what you got."
Benny learned that the best things need time to grow.

title: A Smile Is a Gift 😊
moral: Smiling at others is a kind of charity.
lines: Maya wanted to give charity, but she had no money.
"I have nothing to give," she said sadly.
Adam smiled. "You have something better. Your smile!"
"Our Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, taught that a smile is charity."
So Maya smiled at the old baker. He smiled back!
She smiled at the mailman, and he waved happily.
She smiled at a sad little boy, and he started to giggle.
Soon, the whole street was full of smiles.
Maya learned that a smile is a gift anyone can give.

title: Lina's Bedtime Dua 🌙
moral: When we remember Allah, our hearts feel safe.
lines: Lina couldn't sleep. The wind made spooky sounds outside.
"Mama, I'm scared," she whispered.
Mama sat on her bed and stroked her hair.
"When you feel scared, remember Allah. He is always with you."
"Let's say our bedtime dua together."
Lina closed her eyes and said, "Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya."
It means, in Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
Lina felt warm and safe, like a soft blanket covered her heart.
Soon, she was sleeping peacefully, with a little smile.

title: Benny Says Sorry 💛
moral: Saying sorry can fix a broken friendship.
lines: Benny and Tiko were building the tallest tower of acorns ever.
But Benny bumped it, and the tower crashed down!
"It wasn't me!" Benny said quickly, and ran away.
Tiko sat alone, trying to build it again, with a sad face.
Benny felt a heavy, yucky feeling in his tummy.
He walked back slowly and said, "I'm sorry, Tiko. It was me."
Tiko smiled. "Thank you for telling the truth. Let's build it together!"
This time, their tower was even taller than before.
Saying sorry is hard, but it makes friendships stronger.

title: The Thirsty Kitten 🐱
moral: Allah loves those who are kind to animals.
lines: On a very hot day, Adam and Maya heard a weak little meow.
Under a car, a tiny kitten was shaking. It looked so thirsty.
"Poor kitty," Maya said. "We have to help!"
Adam ran home and brought a bowl of cool water.
The kitten drank and drank, lapping up every drop.
Then it purred and rubbed its head on Maya's hand.
Mama said, "Islam teaches us to be merciful to every living creature."
Adam and Maya named the kitten Sunny and gave her a cozy home.
Being kind to animals makes the whole world softer.

title: The Grumpy Neighbor 🌻
moral: Kindness can melt even the grumpiest heart.
lines: Mr. Omar was the grumpiest neighbor on the whole street.
He never smiled, and he always said, "Go away!"
One day, Lina saw his garden. All the flowers were dry and sad.
So every morning, Lina quietly watered his flowers.
Days later, the garden bloomed with bright yellow sunflowers.
Mr. Omar opened the door and saw Lina with her watering can.
"It was you?" he asked. And for the first time... he smiled!
Now Mr. Omar waves every day and gives Lina sunflower seeds.
Kindness can make even the grumpiest heart bloom.

title: Benny Doesn't Listen 🌊
moral: Listen to your parents. They want to keep you safe.
lines: "Don't go near the river today," Mommy Bunny said. "It's too strong."
But Benny wanted to see the shiny water. Just for one minute!
He hopped to the river and leaned over the edge.
Splash! The bank was slippery, and Benny slid toward the water!
He grabbed a strong root and shouted, "Help! Mommy!"
Mommy Bunny came running and pulled him to safety.
Benny hugged her tight, shaking and wet.
"I'm sorry I didn't listen," he said softly.
Mommy kissed his nose. Rules are there because we love you.

title: The Broken Vase 🏺
moral: Honesty is always the right choice.
lines: Adam was playing ball inside the house. Bounce, bounce... crash!
Mama's favorite blue vase broke into pieces.
Adam froze. Maya gasped. "Uh oh!"
Adam wanted to hide the pieces under the sofa.
But Maya said, "Hiding the truth won't fix it."
When Mama came home, Adam said, "Mama, I broke the vase. I'm sorry."
Mama was sad about the vase, but proud of Adam.
"A vase can be replaced," she said. "But your honesty is precious."
Adam felt so light, like a balloon floating in the sky.

title: Lina's Rainbow Painting 🎨
moral: Mistakes can become something beautiful.
lines: Lina was painting a picture for the school art contest.
But oops! She spilled blue paint all over it!
"It's ruined!" she cried. The contest was tomorrow.
Then she looked closer. The spill looked like a big blue sky.
Lina smiled and grabbed her brushes.
She added a sun, birds, and a giant colorful rainbow.
It became the most beautiful painting she had ever made!
At the contest, everyone gathered around to see it.
Sometimes, a mistake is just the beginning of something amazing.

title: The Giant Rock 🪨
moral: Together we are stronger.
lines: A giant rock rolled onto the forest path. Nobody could pass!
Benny pushed it. It didn't move.
Tiko the squirrel pushed it. It didn't move.
Even little Turtle Toby tried, slowly, slowly. Still nothing.
Then Benny had an idea. "Let's push together!"
One, two, three... push!
The rock began to roll, and rolled right off the path!
All the animals cheered and danced in a big happy circle.
When we work together, nothing is too big for us.

title: Alhamdulillah for Everything 🌈
moral: Being thankful makes us happy.
lines: Adam woke up grumpy. "It's raining! I can't play outside!"
Maya looked out the window and said, "Alhamdulillah for the rain!"
"Why are you thankful?" Adam asked.
"The rain waters the flowers and gives us water to drink!"
Adam thought. "Alhamdulillah for my warm blanket too."
"And for Mama's soup, and for our family!" Maya giggled.
They made a list of everything they were thankful for.
Then, the rain stopped, and a giant rainbow appeared in the sky!
When we say Alhamdulillah, we see blessings everywhere.

title: Don't Waste the Water 💧
moral: Islam teaches us not to waste, even a little.
lines: Lina loved brushing her teeth with the water running... and running.
One day, Grandma gently turned off the tap.
"Lina, do you know how precious water is?" she asked.
"Some children walk very far just to get one bucket of water."
"Allah says in the Quran: eat and drink, but do not waste."
Lina's eyes grew big. She had never thought about that.
From then on, she turned off the tap while brushing.
She even put a little sign on the mirror: Save Water!
Small habits can make a big difference for the world.

title: Who Ate the Cake? 🍰
moral: Always tell the truth, even when it's hard.
lines: Mommy Bunny baked a carrot cake for Grandma's birthday.
"Don't touch it," she said. "It's for tonight."
But it smelled sooo good. Benny took just one tiny bite.
Then another... and another... until half the cake was gone!
"Who ate the cake?" Mommy asked, looking at the crumbs.
Benny's face was covered in frosting. He wanted to blame the cat.
But he took a deep breath and said, "It was me. I'm sorry."
Mommy smiled. "Thank you for being honest. Let's bake a new one together."
Telling the truth always makes your heart feel lighter.

title: The Secret Treasure Map 🗺️
moral: Family is the greatest treasure.
lines: In Grandpa's attic, Adam and Maya found an old treasure map!
A big red X was drawn under the old fig tree.
They grabbed a little shovel and ran outside.
They dug and dug, until... clunk! A wooden box!
Inside, there was no gold. Just old photos and a letter.
The letter said, "My real treasure is my family. Love, Grandpa."
The photos showed Grandpa as a little boy, smiling with his family.
Adam and Maya ran to give Grandpa the biggest hug ever.
Some treasures can't be bought. They are the people we love.

Adam picked up blocks. Maya folded clothes. Zoom, zoom!
Under the last pile of clothes... there was Teddy!
Their room sparkled, and Papa gave them a big high five.
A clean room makes a happy heart.
